category8Metrics.secretsExposureRisk: Covered by static security:audit scanner; active client-bundle secret probing is a follow-up.

findings.title: Probe can reach live API health endpoint
findings.remediation: Start the API or set SECURITY_PROBE_API_URL / --api-url to a reachable app instance.

findings.title: Unauthenticated session endpoint is rejected
findings.remediation: Require auth middleware on session/user endpoints.

findings.title: Invalid session cookie is rejected
findings.details: GET /api/auth/me with fake session_id returned HTTP 401
findings.remediation: Reject unknown or expired session identifiers.

findings.title: Session token has expected high-entropy shape
findings.details: session_id length is 64; expected 64 hex characters
reproductionSteps: Log in through /api/auth/login and inspect the Set-Cookie session_id value shape.

findings.title: Valid session can access authenticated user endpoint
findings.details: GET /api/auth/me with authenticated cookie returned HTTP 200
reproductionSteps: Log in, then request /api/auth/me with the returned session cookie.
findings.remediation: Investigate login/session middleware if this fails.

findings.title: State-changing session request requires CSRF token
reproductionSteps: Log in, then POST /api/issues with the session cookie but without x-csrf-token.
findings.remediation: Apply CSRF protection to cookie-authenticated state-changing routes.

findings.title: Admin-only user list follows the current role boundary
findings.details: Probe account is super-admin; /api/admin/users returned HTTP 200
reproductionSteps: Log in as the probe user and request /api/admin/users.
findings.remediation: Require explicit super-admin checks for admin routes.

findings.title: Unauthenticated events WebSocket is rejected
reproductionSteps: Connect to wss://d9o5hawnpdm4g.cloudfront.net/events without Cookie header.
findings.remediation: Validate session cookies before accepting WebSocket upgrades.

findings.title: Events WebSocket survives malformed and unexpected message types
findings.details: Sent invalid JSON and an unexpected event type over an authenticated /events socket.
reproductionSteps: Log in, connect to /events with Cookie header, send `not-json`, then send `{ "type": "unexpected_security_probe_type" }`.
findings.remediation: Reject malformed messages without crashing and ignore or close on unsupported message types.

findings.title: Unauthorized collaboration document room is rejected
findings.details: Attempted authenticated connection to non-existent/random collaboration room wiki:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.
reproductionSteps: Log in, then connect to wss://d9o5hawnpdm4g.cloudfront.net/collaboration/wiki:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 with Cookie header.
findings.remediation: Verify workspace and document access before WebSocket room join.

findings.title: Stored XSS payload handling on issue title
findings.details: Issue title rejected an HTML event-handler payload.
reproductionSteps: Log in and POST /api/issues with a title containing ``.
findings.remediation: Reject or sanitize HTML-bearing user text at trust boundaries, and keep React output escaped.

findings.title: Excessively long issue title is rejected
reproductionSteps: Log in and POST /api/issues with a 10,000-character title.

details.message: String must contain at most 500 character(s)

findings.remediation: Enforce explicit length limits on all user-facing string fields.

findings.title: SQL injection payload in issue filter does not break query
findings.remediation: Use parameterized SQL and schema validation for all query filters.

findings.title: Malformed ID error does not leak stack traces or SQL
findings.remediation: Return generic validation errors and log detailed stack traces server-side only.

findings.surface: manual review: CORS and CSP configuration
findings.title: CORS does not allow arbitrary hostile origin
findings.details: OPTIONS with Origin https://evil.example returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://d9o5hawnpdm4g.cloudfront.net
findings.remediation: Restrict CORS to the deployed frontend origin and do not reflect arbitrary origins.

findings.title: Oversized WebSocket message is rejected without taking down API health
findings.details: Sent an 11MB payload to authenticated /events socket; follow-up /health returned HTTP 200.
reproductionSteps: Log in, connect to /events, send an 11MB message, then request /health.
findings.remediation: Set maxPayload and close oversized WebSocket messages with code 1009 without crashing the HTTP server.

findings.title: Dependency audit high/critical CVE count
findings.details: pnpm audit reported 0 critical and 0 high advisories.
reproductionSteps: Run `corepack pnpm audit --json` from the repository root.
findings.remediation: Upgrade vulnerable packages or document accepted risk with feature impact and mitigation.
